Container.Name: unraid-app-manager
Container.Overview: Install and update your own apps straight from GitHub repositories: automatic host ports, Nginx Proxy Manager subdomains, private repos and packages, and tiered update checks. Needs the Docker socket, which gives it root-equivalent access to the server.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: HTTP port of the UAM web interface

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encryption key and template backups

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets UAM create and update containers

Config.Name: Unraid user templates
Config.Description: Where 'Write templates to flash' puts my-*.xml files (and where import reads them)

Config.Name: Host /proc (read-only)
Config.Description: Optional: detects ports used by host services and the server's LAN IP

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Optional Fernet key for stored secrets; generated into /data/secret.key when empty

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for scripting the REST API
